caption: Table 27-11. Methods for determining ideal/optimal body weight.
rows: Consult the patient's medical record to determine if a body condition score (BCS) of 3/5 was recorded with a simultaneous ideal body weight.

Consult the patient's medical record to see if the patient's body weight was recorded at about the time the patient reached one year of age. Such a body weight would likely be near ideal (but not always). Thus, this method might not be as reliable as Method 1 above.
Determine patient's current BCS and obtain current body weight.
Locate the current BCS and body weight in Table 27-3.
Note the weight in Table 27-3 that coincides with a BCS of 3/5 in the same column.
